title: Long-haul flights
statementMd:
List flights longer than 10 hours (600 minutes) with their duration.

Expected columns: `id`, `origin`, `destination`, `duration_min`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT id, origin, destination, duration_min FROM flights WHERE duration_min > 600;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
